definition.benchmark: General Benchmark v2: universal closed-loop retrieval workflow
definition.scope: multi-repo adaptive workflow benchmark; strong generalization signal, not a proof over all future projects
definition.task_mix: self repo has locate/snippet/deep/abstract tasks; public OSS repos require path and literal source evidence across Python, JavaScript/Flow, Rust, Go, Java, and TypeScript
definition.trust_model: credible when the fixture repos, commits, task count, trials, and failure rows are reported; the benchmark is designed to expose misses rather than force a win
definition.skygrep_first_path: production agent presets: agent-fast for path decisions, agent-context for first-pass evidence, and bounded deep extraction only after files are known
definition.privacy: public OSS tasks use public repository paths only; absolute roots are redacted
definition.headline_rule: efficiency is reportable only on paired tasks where both policies pass the quality floor and the skygrep policy passes the aggregate noninferiority gate
definition.quality_note: task_completion_quality is a deterministic retrieved-context proxy over paths, literal source facts, noise, sufficiency, and stopping; it is not a graded model-generated final answer
definition.elapsed_note: elapsed_seconds is measured harness wall time including scoring/token counting; tool_elapsed_seconds measures retrieval subprocess/file-read time before token counting; estimated_agent_elapsed_seconds is modelled and never used for the General Benchmark headline
definition.latency_gate_note: release validation requires measured latency fields; it fails only when the quality-eligible median is both more than 25 percent slower than rg and more than one second slower in absolute wall time
definition.token_note: context tokens cover retrieval tool payloads, not model reasoning or provider billing tokens

generalization.claim_scope: paired retrieval-workflow context; excludes model reasoning and provider billing tokens

context_token_median_95pct_ci.method: hierarchical bootstrap over repos then unique tasks; task medians combine trials

generalization.interpretation: Only quality-eligible paired tasks contribute to efficiency headlines. A lower-quality treatment cannot earn a reportable multiplier. Elapsed ratios are rg/skygrep; positive elapsed deltas mean skygrep is slower.
